lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَحُضُّ is in the derivative form: يَحُضُّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ح/ض/ض   ḥ–ḍ–ḍ foot of a mountain, depth, bottom of a valley; to incite, to encourage, to urge.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 3 times in the Qur’an:
يَحُضُّ yaḥuḍḍ 2 times and تَحَاضُّون taḥāḍḍūn 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَحُضُّ yaḥuḍḍ [imperf. of v. حَضَّ ḥaḍḍa, trans.] to urge, to instigate, to encourage

(69:34) وَلاَ يَحُضُّ عَلَى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ he never encouraged feeding the poor.

entries.label: تَحَاضُّون
entries.definitionHtml:
تَحَاضُّون taḥāḍḍūn [imperf. of v. VI تَحَاضَّ taḥāḍḍa, with prefix تـ elided] to urge one another, to encourage one another

(89:18) وَلاَ تَحَاضُّونَ عَلَى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ and you do not urge one another to feed the poor.
